data.name: Jawadat
data.gender_notes: Jawadat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawadat is an Arabic name that signifies generosity, liberality, and open-handedness. It is a quality highly valued in Islamic tradition, where giving to others is seen as a means of purifying one's wealth and soul. The name Jawadat carries the meaning “Generosity and Liberality” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawadat usually hope their child will grow to embody generosity and liberality and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, 'The generous one is near Allah, near Paradise, near the people, and far from Hell.' (Tirmidhi)
data.etymology: Jawadat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generosity and Liberality.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawadat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جوادات
in_arabic.long_meaning: جوادات هو اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذر العربي جواد، والذي يعني الخير والبركات، وهو اسم مشتق من اسم الجواد، وهو اسم لله في الإسلام، والذي يعني الواسع الكريم، وقد ذكر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواقع، وهو اسم شائع في الثقافة الإسلامية، ويعبر عن الخير والبركات

in_urdu.name: جوادات

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Jawadat is associated with the virtue of giving and hospitality. It reflects a deep sense of social responsibility and a commitment to community welfare. The person named Jawadat is expected to be generous, not just in material terms but also in terms of time, energy, and knowledge. This name is often given to children in the hope that they will grow up to be compassionate and selfless individuals who contribute positively to society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Jawadat is a reminder of the importance of giving and sharing in the path of god-consciousness. It is believed that by giving generously, one not only purifies their wealth but also their heart. The act of giving creates a bond between the giver and the receiver, and it is this connection that is seen as a means of drawing closer to the divine. The name Jawadat inspires one to lead a life that is characterized by kindness, compassion, and selflessness. Ultimately, it is a name that encourages us to be grateful for our blessings and to use them to make a positive impact on the world around us.
